name: testland/test-case-anatomy-reference
description: Use when writing a test case template, reviewing a batch of test cases for quality, or migrating cases between tools. Lists the ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-3 and ISTQB test case fields, maps them to TestRail, Xray, Zephyr Scale, Allure TestOps and Qase, and gives a PASS, WEAK or FAIL review rubric.
